items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: with Les Brown -- was 'Tenderly,' which his band later made. (unintelligible) His solo in 'Tenderly' was like Jack Kennedy with 'Stardust,' (unintelligible). that eight bars.

ctx.x: They looked over there and heard this guy. They sat down. The whole 45 minutes. This guy was such a genius, 'til he intrigued everybody, and I never heard nobody play like that in my life. And one of the things I remember we he played -- because I got the record of it now -- of course he played it with Les Brown -- was 'Tenderly,' which his band later made. (unintelligible) His solo in 'Tenderly' was like Jack Kennedy with 'Stardust,' (unintelligible). that eight bars.
